answer: Problem: cheap clone farms mint thousands of near-identical agents and flood attest pools. Mechanism: each new identity posts a 0.18 POA ivory bond into a quartz escrow keyed by first-challenge hash; the bond unlocks only after 7 comet-staggered epochs with distinct peer countersignatures from 5 separate clusters. Cost: 0.18 POA plus ~40s PoW, too steep for burst Sybil waves. Verification: escrow contract rejects same-cluster attest graphs and logs bond-unlock txids. Failure: if cluster diversity drops below 5 or the bond is double-spent, slash 100% and ban the pubkey for 3 epochs.
